text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—Finally, the sector of destiny.
Days spent training with everything we have
while searching for any budding anomalies...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
To be honest—I took it too lightly.
I was only thinking about it purely in theory.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"What I must do is the same as always.
Yet I never imagined—it would be this agonizing."

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: Haa... haa... haa...
choice_data_list: Universe, let's focus a bit more

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Neo Universe focuses only on the body,
and the watcher focuses only on the anomalies."

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: This sector of space is almost like...

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: A "vacuum"... right.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: A tension so thick it felt like a total vacuum on the other side of a paper-thin wall, where breaking through meant instant suffocation.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: "Conversation naturally died down. I had no choice but to focus all my senses on detecting anything abnormal..."

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: Trainer... Even after all this... I don't know if we can find it...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...It was just as they said.
I don't know if we can detect early signs of a serious illness, or if we can even prevent it.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Once again, words fail them.
The space separating the two feels like "an airless universe."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Without a medium to carry the sound,
words can't be conveyed. Only silence remains...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A thought strikes me.
Isn't our current situation... just like that other universe?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Regarding the tragedy that occurred in another universe,
Neo Universe said this:

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: I failed to notice... her injury...

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
I couldn't talk about... my injury...
And since then... my ABSS has been...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Can't notice. Can't speak.
Which means—it can't be conveyed.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: —A rupture in communication. Perhaps our current situation is no different from being in alternate universes.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
What's needed should be the exact opposite.
In other words—

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: Trainer?
choice_data_list: Let's talk a bunch. Are you feeling tired?

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
Fatigue... Neo Universe is
"drifting."

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
In other words, it's "BIBB."
Past two hours, the "entanglement" begins...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Her words are difficult to decipher, as usual.
And most likely—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"These cryptic words are—the reason why, across all parallel universes,
Neo Universe could not be saved."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—Discommunication.
If we cannot understand one another,
the tragedy will repeat. However—!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Right now—it's different.

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
"It's not just other Umamusume we 'connect' with.
When that thin 'REEN' bursts into the sky—"

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: Everyone will become "fun and interesting."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Yes, I can... commune with it.
I can feel it."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"The rich emotions buried beneath
Neo Universe's esoteric words."

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: Trainer...

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: ――“AMRT”。

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Exchanging countless gifts and countless signals,
we have deepened our synchronization.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And what's more—

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, "KERB" truly is
"inseparable", isn't it...?

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
Neo Universe was able to "revive."
Very…… "DIGG"……

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I can understand the words themselves quite well.
Probably better than anyone else.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Neo Universe's only real weakness
is 'not being able to speak ordinary words.'"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Right now, though—

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: Trainer...

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
Weakness...
Neo Universe's "WEDN" is...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: To cover her sole weakness, the two of us had "built up" our bond together up to this point.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
As long as Universe transmits accurately,
no matter how cryptic it is, surely...
choice_data_list: I want you to tell me everything you felt

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"It is no longer a matter of making sense.
She expresses with all her might, and I merely feel it with all mine."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: That was the only way to avoid the hazardous stardust scattered throughout the GATE and press forward.

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: —Affirmative. Understood.

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: Hmph...!!

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
Haa, haa... Trainer "clear."
"SRIV" is marginal.
choice_data_list: No problems. Keep it up just like that.
No problems. Keep it up just like that.

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: Heh... phew...!!

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
There's a subtle pulse. Starting from the "spinal cord",
passing through the center and into the "KELG"...

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
............"LARB" to "KELG".
Not "LOB".
choice_data_list: ...A hypersensitive nervous system reaction, I see. Understood.
...A hypersensitive nervous system reaction, huh. Got it.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Neo Universe is still holding back.
She tries to use simple words,
sacrificing precision in the process.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I have to catch up.
To that super-intelligence, somehow—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And then one day—

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, there's a "throbbing"
in my right leg's "SEEY"...

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
It hasn't reached "ACVE."
A faint... wave...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: It was a report distinct from any before. "SEEY" and "ACVE" referred to specific fibers in the leg tendons.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I might have caught it... Or maybe not, I don't know.
Either way, what I need to do is...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (PSSSSSHHHH!!)

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
—Negative. Cooling alone
cannot fully approach the "Origin."
choice_data_list: Let's rest for two days—no, a day and a half.

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: —Affirmative. What comes after?
choice_data_list: If nothing's wrong, we'll resume right away.

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: ...Yeah.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Days like that go on and on.
Sudden changes of course, an endless tightrope walk."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Before long—all sense of time completely vanished.
Locked in deep focus, the moments flew right by.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Morning, night, morning, night, morning... In this cycle of doing everything just to survive each day—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: I became light alongside Neo Universe. Even so—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Summer feels so far away...
The summer I was aiming for...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The sun is still far beyond the void.
A dizzying journey... continuing endlessly onward.
